searchText: Current rough plans are to open applications for the second cohort (aka cohort-one) on Monday. We'll likely only accept applications through the end of next week, aiming to kick the cohort off by end of Sept at the very latest. I think it's inherited from Bitcoin, e.g. OP_PUSHDATA1 the actual consts are capitalized like that, but the word "OPCODE" just as a noun doesn't stand for anything Are you just using existing applicants or are you going to advertise for new applications? > **open applications** for the second cohort Sounds like new applications to me. Ethereum.org are creating a new 'Ethereum Governance' page. As part of the 'Get Involved' section, we're considering linking out the apprenticeship program. I was just going to use the announcement blog but if there is a better place to link to let me know 🙂 My plan will be to do a full set of new applications. Anyone who previously applied should re-apply. You'll collect a lot of pictures of cute animals! My primary motivation for running the program.... cute animals! lol this is a funny coincidence cuz im just reading these messages, but I had a dream about the next cohort of cdap beginning and there were thousands of people, a lot of high schoolers for some reason, and everyone was taking in a giant mess hall, very similar to hogwarts. but i know it was cdap cuz at one point piper was lecturing everyone from a couch We will be using the sorting hat this time around so you weren't too far off.
